anomalies.impact: An N-channel symbol/part in a high-side P-FET position cannot pass the battery voltage to /BAT and the SW2/R47k gate drive (pull gate low) would turn the wrong channel type off rather than on; the battery path is non-functional and the pinout (G/S/D) is mis-assigned.
